Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Davenport Contemporary Shelf, 34"W, Elm and Metal
Colors: Natural
Elm wood shelving and an airy metal frame give this bookcase a contemporary flair that fits with any decor. The ample space between shelves allows you to keep your home office clutter free. 34"W x 15"D x 70"H Metal frame with elm wood shelves Ample space between shelves can contain books, souvenirs, and art objects. This spacious contemporary bookcase fits with any room and interior design. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
